Agent Name: Verification_Expert
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: They produced an incorrect stop list for the Franklin–Foxboro Line by continuing down the Northeast Corridor past Readville (adding Route 128, Canton Junction, Canton Center, Sharon, Mansfield) and omitting actual Franklin Branch stops (Islington, Norwood Depot, Norwood Central). This mislocated Windsor Gardens and led to an overcount (12 instead of the correct 10).
